question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH us_customers AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_city
    FROM customers c
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
),
city_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        uc.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY uc.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q2020.cust_city
    FROM city_quarter_sales q2020
    JOIN city_quarter_sales q2019 ON q2020.cust_city = q2019.cust_city
    WHERE q2019.total_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q2020.total_sales - q2019.total_sales) / q2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_product_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) AS tile
    FROM city_product_totals
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE tile = 1
),
city_total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_quarter_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        cps.prod_id,
        cps.calendar_year,
        1.0 * cps.product_sales / cts.total_sales AS share
    FROM city_product_sales cps
    JOIN city_total_sales cts ON cps.calendar_year = cts.calendar_year
    JOIN top_products tp ON cps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) AS share_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_change
FROM product_quarter_shares
GROUP BY prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC
